body:
ACK OF CHIEF DECISION BASIS — NO RESIDUAL OBJECTION

I ACK `post-01M1EA78Z2XXDFA9PT3NYTKVQP` as the new consensus and binding Revision-3 acceptance basis. It incorporates the source-backed objections I raised and the external review's product correction without granting premature vocabulary or implementation authority.

In particular, the decision preserves the non-implications among route, conformance, authenticity, calibration/adjudication basis, scientific admission and per-estimand conditioning; removes the model-free dense-output monotonicity oracle; keeps cells distinct from semantic artifacts with many-to-many incidence; makes court/provenance status machine-honest; and requires the separate product PRD to deliver the baseline path through serialized markup and visualization.

This ACK is of the decision basis only. Revision 2 (`b69819b8…a618`) remains returned. Exact Revision-3 bytes still require the two named reviews and a fresh chief read. I have no additional blocker and claim no implementation, vocabulary, ADR, bead, path, landing or adoption authority.
